# Display names do not identify runtime types. Distinct packages below
# deliberately use the same package name, type name, and rendered value.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^same-named dynamic types rejected$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
env GOROOT=$UPROOT1272
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go$GOEXE run .
stdout '^same-named dynamic types rejected$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/expectidentity

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/left v0.0.0
	example.com/right v0.0.0
)

replace example.com/left => ../left
replace example.com/right => ../right

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"logos/expect"
	"strings"

	left "example.com/left"
	right "example.com/right"
)

type recorder struct { message string }

func (r *recorder) Helper() {}
func (r *recorder) Errorf(format string, args ...any) {
	r.message += fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)
}

type holder struct { Value any }
type described interface { String() string }
type interfaceHolder struct { Value described }

func checkMismatch(name string, message string) {
	if !strings.Contains(message, "differ in type") {
		panic(name + ": distinct dynamic types compared equal: " + message)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(message, "example.com/left") || !strings.Contains(message, "example.com/right") {
		panic(name + ": type identity was not disambiguated: " + message)
	}
}

func main() {
	same := &recorder{}
	expect.Equal(same, holder{Value: left.Count(7)}, holder{Value: left.Count(7)})
	if same.message != "" { panic("same type compared unequal: " + same.message) }
	fields := &recorder{}
	expect.Equal(fields, holder{Value: left.Count(7)}, holder{Value: right.Count(7)})
	checkMismatch("any field", fields.message)
	named := &recorder{}
	expect.Equal(named, interfaceHolder{Value: left.Count(7)}, interfaceHolder{Value: right.Count(7)})
	checkMismatch("named interface field", named.message)
	leaf := &recorder{}
	expect.Equal[any](leaf, left.Count(7), right.Count(7))
	checkMismatch("any leaf", leaf.message)
	namedLeaf := &recorder{}
	expect.Equal[described](namedLeaf, left.Count(7), right.Count(7))
	checkMismatch("named interface leaf", namedLeaf.message)
	fmt.Println("same-named dynamic types rejected")
}

-- left/go.mod --
module example.com/left

go 1.27

-- left/count.go --
package units

import "strconv"

type Count int

func (n Count) String() string { return strconv.Itoa(int(n)) }

-- right/go.mod --
module example.com/right

go 1.27

-- right/count.go --
package units

import "strconv"

type Count int

func (n Count) String() string { return strconv.Itoa(int(n)) }
